Hi, I'm Nitin Garg. I have close to 15 years of experience.
I've built and scaled Virtual Platform and SoC modeling solutions across automotive and advanced compute domains.

My core expertise is in SystemC/TLM-2.0, C++/Python, and architecture-level modeling.
I've delivered production IP ( like entire communication stacks CAN-FD, FlexRay, I2C, SPI.) and full virtual platforms for ARM, RH850, and PowerPC-based SoCs 

At Synopsys, I transitioned from hands-on model development into technical leadership—driving digital twin programs and customer engagements with OEMs like Audi and GM.

Later, I architected AI-assisted EDA workflows for secure SoC implementation. I also led cross-geo R&D teams: managing a local team in India while collaborating with large distributed engineering groups and universities globally.

In my current role at Cadence as Sr. Principal Design Engineer, I'm building a Centralized ESW (Embedded Software) development environment that unifies virtual, hybrid, and RTL platforms


Across all roles, my direction has remained consistent:
Accelerate pre-silicon software readiness
Improve model fidelity and performance
Deliver production-grade platform infrastructure both for internal and customer deployments
